name: Middle East Specialized Cables Company
summary: Middle East Specialized Cables Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells fiber optic cables, steel insulated wires and cables, copper insulated wires and cables, and aluminum insulated wires and cables in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. The company offers instrumentation and process cables; power and control cables; fieldbus cables; fire cables; solar cables; cathodic protection cables; low current and communication cables; data and signals cables; building wire; flexible cables; irrigation cables; bare copper; and insulation and sheathing polyvinyl chloride compounds for wire and cable insulation and sheathing applications.
